We are expanding our client base and are looking for a motivated, organised individual to support our business development efforts through structured outreach. About the Role This is a one-month freelance engagement focused on lead generation and cold email outreach on behalf of a UK accounting firm. You will be responsible for building targeted prospect lists, executing a structured 3-step email sequence (guidelines and templates provided), and warming leads through to a calendar booking with the firm's director. This is not a high-volume spray-and-pray role. This is structured, professional, targeted outreach to specific types of UK businesses — quality over quantity. You will be sending a maximum of 5 email s per day, scheduled in advance, meaning the role is manageable in a few focused hours per week. Estimated hours: 5–10 hours per week Hourly rate: $5.00 USD per hour Bonus structure: $10 USD for every qualified lead who books a call on the director's calendar (paid after the call takes place). $40 USD for every client who signs up for a monthly bookkeeping or accounting package (paid after the client's 2nd invoice payment is received by the business). If you are good at this, the bonuses will significantly exceed your base pay. (Please note bonuses will not be paid for filling the calendar with time wasters). Your Ideal Client Target - We are looking for UK-registered Ltd companies that fit the following profile: UK Ltd company (London-based preferred, but all UK accepted — international companies with a UK Ltd entity are also valid) Small to medium-sized businesses with relatively straightforward financials Business owners or directors who are actively running their company and would benefit from outsourced bookkeeping, monthly management accounts, and a proactive accountant relationship Industries: professional services, consultancies, agencies, e-commerce, retail, tech startups, and similar The dream client for our business is a small business (£100k+ rev /year) owner who wants clean books, monthly reports, and a knowledgeable firm they can pick up the phone to — on a simple monthly retainer. That is who you are targeting. Key Responsibilities: Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn search, the Companies House API (free), and AI tools Identify newly incorporated UK Ltd companies via Companies House (daily new registrations) Scope job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Reed) for businesses advertising for bookkeeping or accounting roles — these are warm leads actively seeking the service we provide Monitor LinkedIn for distress signals — businesses posting about accounting problems, late filings, HMRC issues, or switching providers Execute a 3-step structured email sequence per prospect, following firms provided guidelines and templates Send a maximum of 5 outreach email s per day, scheduled in advance Track all leads, outreach activity, email status, and outcomes in an excel/sheets tracking sheet — every contact must be logged Warm leads through to a calendar booking with firms director Report weekly on activity, pipeline, and results Essential Requirements: Proven experience in business development, lead generation, or cold outreach Strong written English — all outreach is professional and on behalf of a UK accounting firm Comfortable using LinkedIn for prospecting and research Able to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to assist with list building and research Organised and self-directed — you will be given guidelines and expected to execute independently Reliable, honest, and transparent — all activity must be accurately tracked Desirable: Familiarity with Companies House or UK business registration data Experience with email outreach tools or scheduling platforms (scheduling in Gmail is acceptable). Understanding of UK small business landscape Tools & Access: A business email account will be provided for outreach Primary research tools: LinkedIn search and Companies House API (both free) AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) encouraged for list research and enrichment If a paid tool is genuinely required and clearly justified, this can be discussed — but the expectation is that the role is achievable using free and AI-powered resources A lead tracking sheet will be provided How to Apply Please submit: A brief cover message explaining your experience in lead generation or cold outreach Any examples of previous outreach work or results achieved Any service based busiiness outreach experience Confirmation that you are comfortable working with UK-based business targets and professional email outreach Confirm you will build a spreadsheet that when complete will integrate into our CRM (access provided in future if ongoing contract)

title: B2B Sales Representative
description: B2B Sales Representative Remote (global, English-speaking) · Full-time · 3–5 yrs outbound experience Hears makes premium hearing protection that people actually want to wear. We started because we couldn't find earplugs we'd be caught dead in at a festival, so we spent two years building our own with world-class acoustic engineers and audiologists. The product won an iF Design Award. DJs, producers, and venues trust it. Our B2B side — festivals, clubs, corporates, retail, music industry — has quietly become one of the most exciting parts of the business. It's also the part with the most upside left to capture. That's why we're hiring. The role You're the second pair of boots on the ground for B2B. You'll work directly alongside our B2B Manager, Luuk, and report into the founding team. The job is simple to describe and hard to do well: open new doors, build a pipeline, and close deals. Your day looks roughly like this: - Cold outreach. LinkedIn, email and phone. Real conversations, not blasted templates. You'll be building sequences, testing angles, and getting on calls with people who didn't know they needed us yesterday. - Owning your pipeline. From first touch to signed deal. You'll qualify,send samples, negotiate and close — with full support from us, but you run the process. - Representing Hears. You're often the first human contact a prospect has with the brand. How you write, call and follow up sets the tone. We care about this a lot. - Working five segments: venues & hospitality, festivals & events, corporate wellbeing, pharmacies & retail, and music industry (labels, studios, artist teams). You'll learn fast which ones convert hardest for you and we'll lean in. - Feeding the machine. Clean CRM hygiene, weekly numbers, honest reporting on what's working and what isn't. We don't need theatre — we need signal. - Running the admin side. Keeping the CRM tidy, logging every touchpoint, tracking deal stages honestly, sending samples on time, following up when you said you would. Half of B2B sales is just doing what you said you'd do, on time. We need someone who treats that as part of the craft, not a chore. What we're looking for - Mid-level. 3–5 years of proven outbound sales experience in B2B. We're not hiring on a script — we're hiring on a track record. If you've consistently hit or beaten quota in an outbound role, we want to talk. Specifically: - 3–5 years in B2B sales or business development, with at least two of those running outbound (not just inbound or account management). - Numbers you can point to. Quota attainment, pipeline generated, deals closed, ACV. We'll ask. Bring receipts. - Native or near-native English, written and spoken. Additional languages (Dutch, German, Spanish, French) are a strong plus. - Fluent with the modern sales stack — Notion LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email sequencing tools, Apollo / Lusha / equivalent. -- You don't need to know our exact tools; you need to be the kind of person who learns them in a week. - Comfortable on the phone. A lot of this role still happens on calls. If cold calling makes you flinch, this isn't the right fit. - Self-driven and remote-ready. You'll be working across time zones with a small team. We measure output, not hours — which only works if you're someone who actually runs themselves. - Bonus points for experience in events, music, hospitality, wellness or premium consumer brands. Genuine personal interest in any of those worlds counts. - Confident and authentic seller. We don't work with scripts and tacky sales tactics you see on socials these days. People buy from people they trust, and the product does half the selling already. What you get - Competitive base + uncapped commission. The more you close, the more you make. Simple. - A real growth path. This is the second B2B hire. The person who shows up and performs has a clear shot at building and leading a team inside 12–18 months. - Full remote. Work from wherever you do your best work, as long as you can overlap meaningfully with European hours. - A product people are actually excited to hear about. Cold outreach is hard. It's a lot less hard when prospects reply with "oh, you guys made these? I love them." - Direct access to founders. No layers. You'll work closely with Luuk on B2B and have a direct line to us on anything that needs unblocking. How we work - Direct, honest, low on corporate theatre. We care about output and we care about the brand. We move fast, we say what we mean, and we expect the same back. If that sounds like your kind of place, you'll like it here. How to apply Send us an email at ---------- with: - Your CV — short and specific is better than long and generic. - A short note (no cover letter required) telling us: the deal you're most proud of closing, and which of our five segments you'd attack first and why. - Optional but appreciated: a 60-second Loom of you pitching a product you love. Doesn't have to be ours. We just want to see how you sound. We read everything. We reply to everyone. — Nick & Bob Co-founders, Hears

Nothing slips through the cracks on your watch. - Extreme Attention to Detail: Every call, every note, every update gets logged correctly in the CRM. title: Cold Caller - Remote (Real Estate)
description: Job Title: Cold Caller (Disposition Focused – Real Estate Wholesaling) Company: Homeward Partners – U.S.-Based Real Estate Investment Firm Location: Remote (Central Time) Employment Type: Full-Time (48 hrs/week) Start Date: Immediate Compensation: Base Pay + Commission + Performance Bonuses How to Apply Please share a 1–2 minute video introduction in English talking about your background, communication experience, and why you’d be a great fit for this role. Drop your WhatsApp Number as well for Quick Communication. About Homeward Partners Homeward Partners is a rapidly growing U.S. real estate investment firm specializing in acquiring off-market residential properties and connecting them with cash buyers and investors. We focus on efficiency, transparency, and results — delivering fair deals to sellers and profitable opportunities to investors. About the Role We’re looking for a Cold Caller with strong communication skills and a great U.S. accent to join our disposition team. Your main responsibility will be to initiate contact with property owners, qualify leads, follow up with interested sellers, and assist in the deal disposition process — helping turn opportunities into closed contracts. Disposition Support Assist the disposition team in following up with warm leads and buyers. Help schedule follow-up calls, send property details, and coordinate buyer communications. Collect feedback from buyers and sellers to support faster deal closures. Communication & Follow-Up Maintain a high daily call volume with professionalism and persistence. Develop rapport and build trust with property owners and investors. Ensure all interactions are logged and categorized correctly in the system. Performance & Growth Meet and exceed weekly targets for call volume, lead generation, and follow-ups. Participate in regular training and performance review sessions. Grow into a Disposition Associate or Disposition Manager role based on performance. Tools You’ll Use Dialer: CallTools / BatchDialer / Mojo Dialer CRM: ReSimpli / Podio / InvestorLift Property Data: PropStream, Zillow, Redfin Communication: Google Workspace, Slack Reporting: Google Sheets, KPI Dashboards Qualifications Excellent spoken English with a U.S. accent (highly preferred). Prior experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or customer service (preferred but not required). Basic understanding of real estate wholesaling or disposition is a plus. Confident, energetic, and motivated to hit performance targets. Tech-savvy and comfortable using CRMs and dialer systems. Strong communication, listening, and persuasion skills. Ability to work during U.S. business hours (Central Time Zone). Compensation & Growth Base pay + attractive commission per closed deal. Performance bonuses for top performers. Paid training with hands-on guidance from the Disposition Team. Clear growth path toward Disposition Associate ? Disposition Manager. Long-term opportunity with a fast-growing U.S. investment firm.

title: Independent Advertising Sales Partner
description: JOB TITLE: Independent Advertising Sales Partner TYPE: Independent Contractor (1099) — Commission-Based LOCATION: Remote · Worldwide (187 Countries) HOURS: Flexible · Set Your Own Schedule START DATE: Immediate · Rolling Applications SECTOR: Digital Media · B2G · B2B · Municipal / Government ABOUT MAYORS & CITIES Mayors & Cities is the premier worldwide municipalities magazine connecting city leaders, government officials, urban planners, and public policy professionals across 187 countries. Published by Secusysts Technologies Inc. (Wilmington, DE, USA), our platform delivers authoritative content on city governance, urban innovation, infrastructure, sustainability, and global municipal cooperation. We serve a highly engaged audience of mayors, deputy mayors, city council members, municipal administrators, and B2G decision-makers — making us one of the most targeted media channels for organizations seeking direct access to city leadership worldwide. THE OPPORTUNITY We are expanding our global advertising sales network and seeking driven, entrepreneurial Independent Advertising Sales Partners to represent Mayors & Cities to advertisers, sponsors, and institutional partners in their regions. This is a remote, commission-based opportunity with no ceiling on earnings. You set your own schedule, work your existing network, and earn competitive commissions on every campaign you close — with performance bonuses for top producers. WHAT YOU WILL DO Prospect and acquire new advertisers across government, NGO, corporate, and institutional sectors Present and sell Mayors & Cities advertising packages: display advertising, sponsored content, newsletter sponsorships, city spotlights, special supplements, and event promotions Manage the full sales cycle, outreach, pitch, proposal, negotiation, close Build long-term relationships with advertisers and renew accounts each cycle Coordinate with the editorial team on campaign delivery and creative assets Submit signed Insertion Orders and ensure smooth campaign onboarding Provide market intelligence and feedback on advertiser needs in your territory ADVERTISING PACKAGES YOU WILL SELL Display Advertising — Banners, sidebar, and in-article placements. Ideal for corporations and NGOs. Sponsored Content — Branded editorial articles. Ideal for governments and development agencies. Newsletter Sponsorship — Email placement directly to city leaders. Ideal for tech and smart-city firms. City Spotlight — Dedicated feature on a city or region. Ideal for city governments and tourism boards. Event Promotion — Conference and summit visibility. Ideal for event organizers and UN agencies. Special Supplement — Thematic branded issue. Ideal for multilateral institutions and corporations. Featured Book / Press Release — Author and organization visibility. Ideal for think tanks and foundations. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Proven track record in media sales, advertising sales, or B2G/B2B business development Existing network in government, public affairs, NGOs, or institutional sectors (a strong asset) Self-motivated, results-driven, comfortable working independently Strong written and verbal communication skills — English required; additional languages a plus Understanding of digital media, content marketing, and advertiser ROI Professional, reliable, representing the Mayors & Cities brand with integrity Familiarity with municipal government or public policy is a significant plus COMPENSATION & COMMISSION STRUCTURE This is a commission-only arrangement. No salary, base pay, draw, or advance is provided. You earn directly from what you close — with no cap on earnings. Commissions are paid on Net Revenue (gross advertising revenue actually received by the Publisher, less any refunds, chargebacks, agency discounts, or authorized deductions) from campaigns closed by you each calendar month, at the following tiered rates: $0.01 — $9,999.99 per month: 20% commission on entire monthly net revenue in this tier. $10,000.00 — $24,999.99 per month: 25% commission on entire monthly net revenue once the $10K threshold is reached. $25,000.00 and above per month: 30% commission on entire monthly net revenue once the $25K threshold is reached. Example: If you close $12,000 in net revenue in a given month, the applicable rate is 25%, resulting in a commission of $3,000 for that month. Additional Terms: Commissions are earned only upon the Publisher's actual receipt of cleared payment from the advertiser. No commission is owed on invoiced but uncollected amounts. The Sales Partner is solely responsible for all costs and expenses incurred in performing services (travel, communications, marketing) unless expressly pre-approved in writing by the Publisher. WHAT WE OFFER Commission rates of 20%, 25%, and 30?sed on monthly net revenue tier No earnings cap — the more you close, the more you earn Full access to Mayors & Cities media kit, rate cards, and sales collateral Dedicated editorial and campaign team support to help you close deals Freedom to work from anywhere in the world on your own schedule The prestige of representing an internationally recognized municipal media brand Potential to grow into a Regional Sales Director role as the network expands NOTE: This is a 1099 Independent Contractor opportunity — not a salaried position. Compensation is exclusively commission-based with no earnings cap. HOW TO APPLY Send your application to: ---------- Subject line: "Sales Partner Application – [Your Name / Region]" Please include: A brief introduction: your sales background and relevant experience Your target territory or region (city, country, or global) Any relevant sector expertise (government, NGO, corporate, media, etc.) Your LinkedIn profile or professional portfolio (optional but recommended)

title: Growth Operations & Business Development Executive
description: We are hiring a Growth & Revenue Operations Consultant to serve as a strategic partner across a portfolio of brands operating in the medical aesthetics and e-commerce sectors. This is a long-term, ongoing engagement — not a one-time project. The successful candidate will work directly with founder-operators to diagnose revenue leaks, build growth strategies, design pricing and membership architectures, and execute the operational changes required to drive measurable revenue lift. This role exists because we have learned the hard way that strategy decks without execution are worthless, and execution without strategy wastes money. We need someone who delivers both — and stays accountable to real numbers over real timeframes. The brands you will work with operate in one or more of the following verticals: • Medical aesthetics & luxury medical spas — injectables, laser, skincare treatments, memberships, packages, retail product sales • Direct-to-consumer e-commerce — skincare, wellness, beauty, lifestyle, and adjacent categories • Service-based businesses with retail/e-commerce arms — hybrid models combining physical service delivery with online product sales • Multi-location and franchise-ready operations — businesses preparing to scale beyond single-location This is a hybrid strategy + execution role. You will be expected to diagnose, design, and deliver. Slide decks alone do not count as deliverables. We measure success by what shipped and what moved. What You Will Own • Full business diagnostics: financials, service revenue, expenses, marketing performance, client retention, operational efficiency • Revenue strategy: pricing architecture, package design, membership programs, retail mix, service profitability analysis • 30/60/90-day growth plans and 12-month revenue roadmaps with quantified targets • KPI architecture: defining what to measure, how to measure it, dashboard design, weekly cadence • Client journey optimization: lead capture ? consultation ? booking ? service ? upsell ? retention ? referral • Business development strategy for local partnerships, B2B pipelines, corporate wellness, and influencer/creator collaborations • Marketing operations oversight: campaign ROI review, channel allocation, cost-per-acquisition optimization • Vendor and specialist coordination: directing CRM leads, web developers, content directors, and outreach reps • Weekly performance reporting and direct accountability to founder-operators Required Skills & Experience • Minimum 5 years of demonstrable experience in growth operations, revenue strategy, or business development for service-based or e-commerce businesses • Proven track record of measurable revenue lift across at least 3 prior clients or businesses (you will be required to submit redacted case studies — see Application Requirements) • Hands-on experience with pricing strategy, package design, and membership/recurring revenue programs • KPI design and dashboard construction (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Airtable, or equivalent) • Client journey mapping and conversion funnel optimization • Sales pipeline architecture and lead follow-up systems • CRM and marketing automation literacy (you do not need to build it — you must direct it competently) • Project management and vendor/specialist coordination across remote teams • Direct, accountable communication with founder-operators (no hand-holding required, no excuses tolerated) • Comfort working with confidential financial data under NDA Preferred Background • Prior in-house or fractional experience with medical aesthetics, beauty, wellness, healthcare, or luxury service businesses • Direct experience scaling a founder-led service business from single-location to multi-location or franchise model • E-commerce growth experience (Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, or comparable) • Working knowledge of GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo, or comparable platforms • Hands-on experience with at least one major booking platform (Vagaro, Jane App, Boulevard, Mangomint, Zenoti, or AestheticsPro) • Local SEO, Google Business Profile, and reputation management literacy • Meta Ads and Google Ads strategic oversight (you do not run the ads — you evaluate them) • Familiarity with HIPAA-adjacent data handling and compliance considerations in medical/aesthetic contexts Tools & Platforms You Should Understand You do not need to be expert in every platform listed below. You need to know what each one does, when to use it, and how to direct the specialist who owns it. If more than 30% of these are unfamiliar, this role is likely not a fit. • CRM & Automation: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Keap, ActiveCampaign, ---------- , Zapier, n8n, Twilio • Booking & Operations: Vagaro, Jane App, Boulevard, Mangomint, Zenoti, AestheticsPro • E-Commerce: Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Square • Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, Meta Business Suite • Marketing Tools: Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Canva, Metricool, Later, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity • Productivity: Notion, Airtable, ClickUp, Asana, Google Workspace, Slack, Loom • Financial: QuickBooks, Xero, Stripe Dashboard, payment processor reporting Initial Deliverables • Full business diagnostic report covering revenue, operations, marketing, client journey, digital infrastructure, and financials • Top 10 revenue leaks identified with quantified dollar impact estimates • Draft 30/60/90-day growth plan with weekly milestones • Draft KPI dashboard with metrics, sources, and review cadence • Recommended hiring sequence for any additional specialists needed • Initial pricing, package, and membership recommendations with rationale • Quick-win execution list: 5–10 items implementable within the first 30 days Ongoing Deliverables • Weekly written report covering wins, blockers, metrics, risks, and next priorities • Monthly performance review tied to defined KPIs • Quarterly strategic refresh and roadmap recalibration • Continuous coordination of vendor and specialist team • Documented SOPs for every system, workflow, and strategy put in place • Loom walkthroughs for every major deliverable Long-Term Opportunity This is not a short-term gig. We are building long-term strategic capacity across multiple brands. The right consultant can expect: • Stable, ongoing engagement across multiple growing brands in adjacent verticals • Direct access to founder-operators (no middle management layer) • Opportunity to expand scope into Fractional CGO or Head of Growth role • Equity participation or revenue-share structures for high-performers after demonstrated results • Coordination authority over a remote team of specialists (CRM, web, brand, BD, conversion) • First-look at additional consulting engagements as portfolio expands Application Requirements — Read Carefully 1. Identity & Profile Verification • Full name and verifiable LinkedIn profile (active, public, with documented work history) • Resume or professional CV (PDF only, no Google Doc links) • Time zone, working hours, and earliest start date • Internet speed screenshot (minimum 50 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up) — required for remote execution roles 2. Required Portfolio Submissions (Non-Negotiable) Submit redacted but verifiable evidence of at least three (3) prior engagements where you delivered measurable revenue or operational impact. For each one, include: • Business type, industry, and approximate revenue size at the time of engagement (revenue brackets acceptable, e.g., $500K–$1M, $1M–$5M) • The specific problem you were hired to solve • Your scope of work and the strategies you designed • What you actually executed or oversaw — not just what you recommended • The measurable outcome with real numbers (revenue lift, CAC reduction, conversion rate improvement, retention gains, etc.) • The timeframe over which the results were achieved • Screenshots, dashboard exports, or redacted documents that demonstrate the work (no documents = no consideration) Case studies without quantified outcomes will be discarded. Verbal claims of "helped grow the business" are not acceptable. Show numbers, sources, and proof. 3. Required Video Introduction Submit a Loom or video introduction (5–10 minutes maximum) covering, in this order: • Who you are and your professional background • The two engagements you are most proud of, and why • Your typical diagnostic process when starting with a new brand • How you d ---------- what to prioritize when a founder has 20 ideas and only 3 are worth doing • Your communication style and how you handle pushback from founders • Why you want this role specifically — not consulting in general 4. Sample Strategic Thinking Submission Write a 300–500 word response to the following hypothetical scenario: "A medical aesthetics business is doing $40,000/month in revenue with 60% margin. They have 200 active clients but only 15% return for a second visit within 90 days. Their average ticket is $280. They run Meta Ads at $3,200/month with a cost-per-lead of $42 and a lead-to-booking conversion of 18%. What three diagnostic questions would you ask first, what would you suspect is the biggest revenue leak, and what would your first 30 days look like?" We are looking for sharp diagnostic thinking, not generic consultant-speak. Show your reasoning. Screening Questions Answer each of the following in 3–5 sentences. Direct, specific answers only. Generic responses will be filtered out. 1. How would you evaluate where a service-based business is losing money or opportunities in the first 14 days of an engagement? 2. What KPIs would you track weekly for a luxury service business, and how would you prioritize them? 3. How would you d ---------- which services, packages, or memberships to promote over others? 4. Walk us through how you build a 30/60/90-day growth plan that founders actually execute. 5. How would you improve lead follow-up and booking conversion in a business where leads come in but never get worked properly? 6. What is your approach to building local business development partnerships in a service category? 7. What reports or data would you request from a new client in week one, and why? 8. Describe a time you turned business data into a growth plan that shipped — with the actual outcome. 9. How do you stay accountable to measurable results when working remotely with founder-operators? 10. What is your approach when a founder has 20 ideas and only 3 are worth prioritizing right now? How to Apply Submit all of the following in a single application package: • Resume / CV (PDF) • LinkedIn profile URL • Three (3) case studies with quantified outcomes (PDF) • Loom or video introduction link (3–10 minutes) • Sample strategic thinking submission (300–500 words) • Two (2) verifiable client references • Internet speed screenshot • Stated availability and earliest start date The first line of your application must read: REVENUE OPERATOR Applications that do not begin with this keyword will not be reviewed. This is the first filter. We use it to identify candidates who actually read the posting end-to-end. Compensation Structure This is a serious, performance-linked engagement. Compensation reflects the seniority and ownership level required, and is structured collaboratively based on what each side brings to the table. We pay competitively for the right person. • Structure: Monthly retainer, hourly, or hybrid — open to discussion based on what works for both sides • Rate: Competitive and reflective of senior-level expertise. We expect candidates to state their preferred structure and rate in their application, supported by their track record • Performance bonus: Available on top of base compensation, tied to documented revenue lift, KPI achievement, or milestone delivery • Initial term: 90-day engagement with quarterly renewal based on results • Long-term opportunity: Equity-aligned partnership, fractional executive role, or expanded portfolio scope available for the right candidate after demonstrated results

title: HIGH-TICKET SALES & CUSTOMER CARE COORDINATOR
description: HIGH-TICKET SALES & CUSTOMER CARE COORDINATOR High Ticket Outdoor Products / Custom Coop Industry Remote Role – Philippines Preferred Long-Term Growth Opportunity US CENTRAL TIME ZONE POSITION This position requires substantial overlap with United States Central Time (CST/CDT) business hours. THIS IS NOT: A basic customer service position A passive VA role A copy-and-paste support job An order-taking-only role This is a sales-focused coordination role inside a fast-growing high-ticket outdoor products company. Our customers are purchasing: Premium chicken coops Duck coops Outdoor buildings Custom poultry setups Large-ticket specialty products Purchases often range from several thousand dollars to well over five figures. This role combines: Sales coordination Customer communication Project guidance Logistics coordination Relationship management And sometimes even helping customers design dream coop setups for their property HIGH-TICKET SALES EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED Minimum 3 years of high-ticket sales, sales coordination, or customer-facing sales experience is required. Customers often spend days or weeks researching, comparing options, discussing layouts, and planning their purchase before making a final decision. You must feel comfortable: Guiding detailed customer conversations Following up consistently Managing longer sales cycles Handling high-value purchasing decisions professionally Communicating with warm, relationship-based sales energy rather than aggressive sales tactics Experience in the outdoor building or coop industry is NOT required. EXPERIENCE THAT IS STRONGLY PREFERRED High-ticket sales Sales coordination Quote follow-up Inside sales Appointment setting CRM management Customer retention Long sales cycle businesses Financing coordination Logistics coordination Additional experience that is a major plus: Shopify HubSpot or CRM systems Gmail inbox management Google Docs & Google Sheets Text and email -based sales communication WHO THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR We are looking for someone who is: Warm and personable Friendly and conversational Professional without sounding robotic or corporate Highly detail oriented Organized across many moving parts and conversations Calm under pressure Proactive and dependable Comfortable communicating by phone, text, email , and Zoom Comfortable learning product layouts, shipping logistics, and customization options Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment This role is NOT about aggressive sales tactics. It IS about: Building relationships Communicating clearly Following through consistently Keeping customers comfortable and informed Helping customers confidently navigate major purchasing decisions WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING Following up with warm inbound leads Helping customers through the quote process Guiding customers toward purchasing decisions Answering customer questions by phone, text, and email Re-engaging customers who go quiet Helping customers compare layouts and options Collecting measurements, site photos, and project details Coordinating shipping and delivery communication Assisting customers with financing information and next steps Updating CRM notes and customer records Helping create a smooth and personal customer experience from first inquiry through delivery WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE FUN & DIFFERENT This is not a boring call-center role or generic customer support position. You’ll help customers design dream coop setups for their families, homesteads, and farms while guiding them through exciting purchasing decisions. Customers regularly share: Chicken and duck photos Coop setup progress Finished deliveries Custom layout ideas Flock updates For the right person, this role can actually be a lot of fun. If you enjoy: Talking with people Design conversations Relationship-based sales Homesteading and outdoor living Helping customers bring projects to life …you’ll probably enjoy this role far more than a typical support position. VERY IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY This is a relationship-based sales role, not aggressive high-pressure sales. Strong communication, organization, follow-up, and trust-building are extremely important. We are looking for someone who can: Communicate warmly and professionally Stay organized across many conversations Follow through consistently Keep customers comfortable and informed Help guide high-value purchasing decisions confidently We are NOT looking for robotic, scripted, or overly corporate communication. THIS ROLE IS NOT A GOOD FIT FOR SOMEONE WHO: Waits to be told every step Avoids follow-up Gives short robotic replies Disappears under pressure Struggles with organization Cannot confidently guide conversations Has multiple simultaneous jobs that interfere with responsiveness Is uncomfortable communicating with customers frequently throughout the day OUR PRODUCTS & CUSTOMERS Customers often have questions involving: Custom coop layouts Shipping logistics Site preparation Gate clearance and access Ventilation upgrades Electrical add-ons Duck and goose setups Breed-specific configurations Financing options Delivery timing Customizations You do not need prior coop industry experience, but you must be comfortable learning detailed product and logistics information over time. BASIC MATH REQUIREMENTS You should be comfortable with: Calculating square footage Reading measurements and layouts Basic algebra Understanding dimensions and spacing Helping customers understand coop capacity recommendations You do not need advanced math skills, but you should feel comfortable working with numbers confidently and accurately. IDEAL CANDIDATE You should: Be dependable Learn quickly Communicate clearly and confidently Be proactive rather than reactive Care deeply about customer experience Have strong internet/audio/video quality Be willing to work a schedule overlapping United States Central Time business hours, particularly during peak activity periods between 10 AM and 7 PM CST/CDT Be comfortable with Zoo ---------- etings and customer phone calls PAY STRUCTURE Compensation depends on experience and qualifications and will be discussed during the interview process. Base pay plus performance incentives Long-term growth opportunities available Advancement opportunities for the right person MANDATORY APPLICATION TASK — READ CAREFULLY DO NOT apply with: Generic copy-and-paste applications One-line introductions Resume-only submissions Applications without a VIDEO introduction will be ignored. YOU MUST SEND: 1. A 2–3 Minute Video Introduction (YouTube or Google Drive) In your video: Introduce yourself professionally Explain your relevant experience Explain why you would be a good fit Demonstrate your communication style Respond to this customer scenario: “A customer says they love the coop, but they are nervous about spending thousands of dollars online and are unsure about the shipping cost. How would you respond?” 2. Written Response Task Scenario 1 “A customer received a shipping quote and has not responded for 5 days. Please write a short follow-up message you would send by text or email to reconnect with the customer naturally and professionally.” Scenario 2 Customers often ask how many chickens can comfortably fit inside different coop sizes. A comfortable amount of interior coop space is approximately: 4 square feet per chicken Please calculate the square footage and approximate comfortable chicken capacity for: Coop A: 6 ft × 8 ft Coop B: 8 ft × 12 ft Then briefly explain: Which coop provides more interior space Approximately how many additional chickens it could comfortably accommodate FINAL NOTE We are building a long-term team for a fast-growing niche business with high standards for communication, responsiveness, organization, and customer experience. This role is best suited for someone who is: Proactive Organized Detail oriented Strong with people Comfortable with sales conversations Excited to grow long term with a company If you are looking for a casual side role, this probably is not the right fit. If you are dependable, ambitious, organized, and genuinely enjoy helping customers through important purchasing decisions, we would love to hear from you.

job_title: Real Estate Cold Caller — Long-Term Role with US Investment Company
description: About Us We're a US-based real estate investment/wholesale company that buys houses directly from homeowners in Ohio. We're a small, fast-moving team and we're hiring a sharp, reliable cold caller to work with us long-term. If you perform well, there's real room to grow — more hours, raises, and lead-based bonuses are all on the table as we scale. What You'll Be Doing You'll call homeowners from a list we provide and follow a simple script. This is NOT a hard-sell role. Our leads are highly targeted — we're calling property owners who match specific criteria, so most of the heavy lifting is done before you ever dial. Your job on each call: Make outbound calls using our dialer (Mojo Dialer — we'll train you) Follow our script (it's short and straightforward) Confirm if the homeowner is open to selling their property Ask two simple qualifying questions: timeframe and price Hand the qualified lead off to me and my partner for the follow-up call Log every call and lead accurately in our system That's the entire role. We handle the deal-making, negotiating, and closing. You're the first voice they hear — we need that voice to sound professional, warm, and confident. What We're Looking For Required: Fluent, clear English with minimal accent — non-negotiable. You'll be speaking with American homeowners, many of them older, and they need to understand you easily on the first try. Confident, friendly phone presence — calm, never pushy Reliable high-speed internet (25 Mbps or higher) and a quiet workspace Quality USB headset with noise cancellation Available 3 hours per day, Monday–Friday, during US Eastern Time business hours Ability to follow a script accurately Strong note-taking and attention to detail Coachable — open to feedback and willing to improve Nice to have (not required): Previous cold calling or telemarketing experience Previous experience in US real estate (wholesaling, acquisitions, or dispositions) Familiarity with Mojo Dialer or similar dialers Familiarity with Podio CRM Why This Role Is Different Most cold calling jobs are brutal — random lists, angry homeowners, hundreds of dials with nothing to show. Ours isn't like that. Our lists are targeted, so the conversations are generally calm. The script is short and we've removed the parts that usually trip new callers up. If you can hold a normal conversation in English, follow a simple flow, and take good notes, you'll do well here. We respect your time. We pay on time. We don't micromanage. We just want someone reliable who shows up, follows the script, and helps us build the pipeline. How to Apply To apply, please send a message that includes: A voice recording (1–2 minutes) of you introducing yourself in English and reading the following two sentences out loud: "Hey Mr. Johnson, this is Mark. I was reaching out to see if you would be interested in selling the house on 1247 Maple Street? Awesome, thank you — while I'm getting your property pulled up, can I ask you a couple of quick questions so I can pass everything along to my partner?" Brief answers to these questions: Do you have previous cold calling experience? If yes, what industry and how long? Do you have previous US real estate experience? If yes, please describe. What is your internet speed? (Please run a quick speedtest.net and tell me the result.) What headset/microphone setup do you use? Are you currently working another job? If yes, are you confident you can commit to 15 hours/week during EST business hours? What time zone are you in, and what hours can you reliably work? ?? Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. This is the most important part of your application. Hiring Process Review of voice recording and written application Short video interview (10-15 minutes) Paid trial week (15 hours, $4/hr) to confirm fit Long-term hire What I Will NOT Tolerate Showing up late or missing scheduled shifts without notice Going off-script or making promises to sellers we can't keep Lying on call notes or skipping leads Heavy accents that homeowners struggle to understand If any of those are issues, this isn't the role for you. But if you're reliable, coachable, and want a stable long-term position with a company that treats you well — apply. Looking forward to hearing from you.
